name: Cloak of Arachnida

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Web
powers.text: Once per dawn, cast Web (save DC 13), up to twice the normal area.

summary: Resistance to Poison, climb like a spider, webs can't hold you, and a daily Web.
text: Woven of black silk shot through with faint silver threads, this cloak grants Resistance to Poison damage and a Climb Speed matching your Speed, and lets you scuttle up, down and across walls and along ceilings with your hands free. Webs of any kind can't trap you, and you move through them as though they were Difficult Terrain. Once per dawn you can also cast Web (save DC 13) from the cloak, and that web covers double the usual area.
